description: A number written with Arabic-Indic digits.

divergence.note: The integer pattern uses d, which is Unicode-aware in Python, and int() then accepts the digits, so "٢٠" converts to 20. docs/grammars.md fixes d as ASCII for this product, and a value one engine reads as a number and the other refuses breaks mutual readability of the same file. The Dart implementation refuses it with env_conversion.
